queue.title: Canonical benchmark reconstruction and regression certification
Fresh benchmark v2 preregistration and calibration controls
queue.conclusion: Benchmark v2 is reproducibly executable and prospectively frozen. In 12 fresh worlds width2-width1 edge error was -0.1962 with bootstrap 95% CI [-0.6877,+0.3173]; MAP was 58.3% vs 41.7%. Breadth superiority remains unresolved.

queue.title: Powered breadth replication on frozen benchmark v2
queue.conclusion: Frozen benchmark-v2 width-2 breadth shows no resolved primary advantage at n=48 and costs about 2.06x planner simulations. Do not claim unconditional breadth superiority on benchmark v2.

queue.title: Breadth novelty and redundancy mechanism audit
queue.hypothesis: The null benchmark-v2 breadth effect is caused by action-space redundancy: the extra swarm frequently proposes interventions that are duplicates or near-duplicates of width-1 rather than supplying genuinely novel high-EIG actions.
queue.design: Using the frozen benchmark-v2 engine and fresh diagnostic seeds, instrument both proposal swarms before selection. Measure exact action duplication, target duplication, EIG rank of extra-swarm candidates, selected-action provenance, and incremental EIG of width-2 over width-1. This is a mechanism audit, not another adaptive breadth threshold test.

checkpoint.next_action: Freeze R4 diagnostic protocol, add proposal-set instrumentation without changing policy behavior, run 12 fresh diagnostic worlds, and evaluate whether extra-swarm novelty predicts any paired recovery benefit.

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Initial-state and local-margin depth gates failed to justify deeper search.

Uniform width-2 proposal breadth improved edge recovery in the unrecoverable historical benchmark lineage, but that implementation cannot be exactly resumed and its effect must not be assumed to transfer to benchmark v2.
The historical width-2 gain was a portfolio effect rather than one globally best extra role.
Simple adaptive breadth thresholds failed strict historical validation.
Under nonlinear ground truth, forcing linear-Gaussian inference sharply degrades absolute recovery and does not preserve the historical width-2 advantage.
Nonlinear-aware local likelihoods repair much absolute recovery under nonlinear ground truth, but breadth remained unresolved at n=96.
A simple model-disagreement proposal bonus changes many choices but worsens edge recovery prospectively.
Naive terminal trajectory credit remains directionally promising but unresolved and does not justify replacing the unweighted controller.
A single unmodeled latent common cause can reverse the historical breadth advantage; robustness requires model-class changes rather than more proposals alone.
Historical EXP-002 powered runs are not exactly resumable because executable mechanics and per-world seed/state lineage were not persisted.
Repository archaeology confirms the historical executable mechanics were not committed; corrected total intervention-cost budget is 15.
Untuned canonical-v1 reconstruction passed 29,281-DAG structural invariants but failed behavioral regression, so historical transfer experiments remain nonpoolable.

Fresh benchmark v2 now has a frozen executable engine, exact 29,281-DAG posterior support, budget 15, strict nested breadth, posterior-predictive EIG scoring, isolated RNG namespaces, and a source-addressed manifest.

On benchmark v2, the 12-world screen favored width-2 directionally but remained unresolved; the preregistered 48-world replication collapsed to a null primary effect: mean width2-width1 edge error +0.0140, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.2420,+0.2754], identical 60.4% MAP recovery, with about 2.06x planner simulations. Unconditional width-2 superiority is therefore not supported on benchmark v2.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
